name: Can I perform commercial mold remediation myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform commercial mold remediation myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While small, surface mold growth in an office bathroom might be manageable with household cleaners, commercial mold infestations are often extensive and require professional expertise. Mold can hide behind walls, under flooring, and in HVAC systems, requiring specialized equipment for detection and removal. Attempting DIY remediation without proper containment and safety measures can spread spores, worsen the problem, and expose occupants to health risks. Professional remediation ensures thorough removal, proper disposal, and prevents recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, commercial mold remediation typically requires professional expertise and equipment due to the potential for hidden mold, spore spread, and health risks.
